_comment: o3d-o8cp. Suppressions for scripts/check-documented-env-vars.mjs. Every entry needs a reason of at least 24 characters, so that suppressing an entry is a decision someone wrote down rather than a silent exception. A stale entry (no longer documented, or now genuinely read) fails the check rather than lingering.

documentedButUnread.APP_PORT: Consumed by shell, not by application code: scripts/update.sh reads it back out of .env for its health probe, and scripts/install.sh uses it to build the nginx upstream and the cron base URL. The Node process gets its port from PORT in the systemd unit.
documentedButUnread.BD_GIT_HOOK: Consumed by the beads (bd) git hook, which is developer tooling outside this application's process.
documentedButUnread.BEADS_HOOK_TIMEOUT: Consumed by the beads (bd) git hook, which is developer tooling outside this application's process.
documentedButUnread.NODE_PG_FORCE_NATIVE: Read by the INSTALLED node-postgres itself (pg/lib/index.js), never by this repository. docs/installation.md names it because scripts/install.sh REFUSES to derive the application's pg_hba route when it is set - setting it swaps node-postgres for libpq, which fills sslmode, gssencmode, service and host from the environment again (o3d-2sm1.5 r44). Documenting a variable this repository must not read is the point of the entry, not an oversight.
documentedButUnread.QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_ID: A real instance of the o3d-esha defect, deliberately left open: QuickBooks is deprioritised (connector priority 2026-08) and the real control is the quickbooks_client_id setting written by the OAuth flow. Wire it up or delete the documentation when QuickBooks work resumes.
documentedButUnread.QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_SECRET: A real instance of the o3d-esha defect, deliberately left open: QuickBooks is deprioritised (connector priority 2026-08) and the real control is the quickbooks_client_secret setting. Wire it up or delete the documentation when QuickBooks work resumes.
documentedButUnread.QUICKBOOKS_COMPANY_ID: A real instance of the o3d-esha defect, deliberately left open: QuickBooks is deprioritised (connector priority 2026-08) and the realm id is written to the quickbooks_company_id setting by the OAuth callback. Wire it up or delete the documentation when QuickBooks work resumes.
documentedButUnread.SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN: A real instance of the o3d-esha defect, deliberately left open: Shopify is deprioritised (connector priority 2026-08). Same shape as WC_STORE_URL - the three Shopify secrets have SETTING_ENV_FALLBACKS entries and the store domain does not. Resolve it the way WC_STORE_URL was: SEED the setting once at install time in scripts/provision-instance.mjs rather than adding an env override, which would repoint an upgraded install at a stale store.
